description: This file implements the StreamBufferCache class, which manages a cache of stream buffers for camera hardware, providing methods to get, remove, update, and clear cache entries, as well as to remove streams except specified ones.

classes.name: StreamBufferCache
classes.description: A class that manages a cache of stream buffers for camera hardware.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached stream buffer by its buffer ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a stream buffer from the cache by its buffer ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the cache with a new or existing stream buffer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: removeStreamsExcept
methods.description: Removes all stream buffers except those associated with specified stream IDs.
